definition.question: How deadlocked are US-Iran talks and ceasefire efforts for the Gulf?
definition.low_end: Active direct negotiations with agreed framework for ceasefire, Hormuz reopening, and sanctions relief.
definition.high_end: Complete diplomatic rupture with no channels, no mediators, and no prospect for talks or ceasefire.

readings.rationale: First indirect shuttle talks in months occurred Sept 22-23 via Qatari mediators (Witkoff/Kushner-Araqchi) aiming only for a short-term restart, but Iran demands lifting blockade, asset release and end to war on all resistance fronts while US demands public halt to ship attacks and open toll-free lanes; June interim deal collapsed over Hormuz control/fees and both sides expect the other to blink.…
